$comment: Process evals for the warrant plugin. These assert that the pipeline's own invariants hold, not that a model behaved well. Each id maps to a check in run_evals.sh.

evals.asserts: every script in scripts/ exposes --help, --root, --json, --now and --selftest
evals.why: a gate whose flags differ from its siblings is a gate nobody can script around
the self-tests are the only evidence the rules were written rather than described

evals.asserts: every script's --selftest contains at least one case that observes a rule FAILING
evals.why: a rule only ever observed passing has not been written

evals.asserts: no script imports a third-party module
evals.why: a verification tool with a dependency tree stops running

evals.asserts: charter_validate.py exits 3 with no warrant, and 2 on each of its six named failures
evals.why: the outermost gate must distinguish absent from invalid

evals.asserts: ledger_verify.py exits 2 on a single flipped byte in a historical row
evals.why: a ledger that cannot detect tampering proves nothing

evals.asserts: blind_queue.py builds the reviewer artifact from an allowlist so a verdict cannot reach it, and exits 2 when --carry would leak one
evals.why: I5: a reviewer who has seen the verdict is no longer measuring anything

evals.asserts: escape_report.py exits 1 when asked for a rate
evals.why: C19: feedback is a numerator with no denominator

evals.asserts: adjudicate.py exits 1 on --majority and routes a valid disagreement to the settling check with no winner named
evals.why: C2: majority logic is the measured failure

evals.asserts: ratchet.py exits 4 and drops the class to tier 0 when a pinned model version changes
evals.why: C12: the control changed, so the benchmark no longer holds

evals.asserts: _state.tier_of() returns 0 for a class the warrant does not name
evals.why: a class nobody wrote down is a class no machine may close

evals.asserts: lot_report.py exits 2 when any of its five required fields is absent
evals.why: a rate without its population is the C19 error

evals.asserts: every claim id cited in a SKILL.md or reference resolves in docs/deep-research/claims.json
evals.why: a rule nobody can trace is a rule nobody should follow

evals.asserts: no SKILL.md or reference fails the agent-voice lint at format=skill
evals.why: an unmeasurable qualifier in an instruction file is a slot the runner fills with its own priors

evals.asserts: every flag and positional a SKILL.md or reference shows exists on that script
evals.why: a skill documenting a flag the script lacks fails at runtime for everyone who installs it; this gate found 13 such mismatches on the first build
